notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in hand.
You control a Swamp.
description:
Activate a Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a creature card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return any creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind over Matter ability, untapping a Swamp you control.
Repeat.
